description: This Kotlin source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android app. It sets up the main UI components including a ViewPager2 for switching between calendar views (Month/Week/Day), a BottomNavigationView for navigation, and a FloatingActionButton to trigger event creation. It also initializes network client and handles UI interactions.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class managing the calendar application's primary UI and interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the main user interface with tab navigation, view pager for calendar views, and a floating action button for creating new events. Sets up event handlers for UI interactions.
